landing_faq_free_a: Yes. Creating an account, publishing, and forking itineraries is free.
landing_faq_fork_q: What does forking an itinerary mean?
landing_faq_fork_a: Forking copies the whole itinerary into your profile — days, stops, and tips — as an editable starting point.
landing_faq_private_q: Can I keep an itinerary private?
landing_faq_private_a: Yes. Private itineraries are only reachable through an invite link, for you and your travel companions.
landing_faq_ai_a: You describe the destination, length, and style; the AI drafts a day-by-day plan you review and edit before publishing.
